name: search_api
description: Search across public API endpoints matching a natural-language query. Returns a ranked list of matching endpoints with their signatures and short descriptions. Use this tool when the user asks about API capabilities without naming a specific endpoint.

query.description: Natural-language description of what the caller is looking for.

api_version.description: Which API version to search. Defaults to the latest stable version.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

include_deprecated.description: Include endpoints marked as deprecated in the results.
